prompt_text: My name is Alexis, I've got three sisters, each one of them has 1 brother. How many brothers do I have ?
response_text:
The key is to look at what “each one of them has 1 brother” means.

- You (Alexis) have three sisters.  
- Each of those sisters has exactly **one** brother.  

If there were any other brothers besides you, then each sister would have **more than one** brother (you plus the other brother(s)). Since each sister has only one brother, that brother must be the same person for all three sisters – and that person is you.

Therefore, you are the only brother in the family.  

**So you have 0 brothers.** (You are the brother.)
